units.source_text: 那时，妻子抚摸着K的墓石说：‘真气派。’

en.t: At that moment, my wife stroked K's gravestone and said, "How splendid."

units.source_text: 其实那个墓并没有多么奢华，大概是因为我亲自到石料铺挑选碑石的缘故，妻子才这样说的吧。

en.t: In fact, the grave was not especially luxurious; perhaps my wife said that because I had gone to the stonecutter's myself to choose the monument.

units.source_text: 我望着这座新坟墓和我的新婚妻子，再联想到刚刚埋入地下的K的‘新’白骨，不能不感到命运的嘲讽。

en.t: As I looked at this new grave and at my new wife, and then thought of K's "new" white bones only just buried underground, I could not help feeling the irony of fate.

units.source_text: 从那以后，我就绝不和妻子一起去给K扫墓了。

en.t: From then on, I never again went with my wife to visit K's grave.
